title: Criteria to Qualify Companies to Conduct Workforce Skills Qualifications Courses
what_it_is: Criteria to Qualify Companies to Conduct Workforce Skills Qualifications Courses

sections.label: ATO standards and audits
sections.summary: Training providers must meet standards before appointment as ATOs, and SSG audits them for renewal of their application.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Learning and Skills))
sentences.text: The training provider must meet these standards and requirements before it is appointed as an ATO to deliver WSQ programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Learning and Skills))
sentences.text: To ensure that continued compliance, SSG regularly audits the ATOs' systems and processes and the outcomes of such audits are reviewed and considered by SSG for the renewal of the ATOs' application to offer training.

sections.label: MySkillsFuture community feedback feature
sections.summary: SSG introduced a community feedback feature in the MySkillsFuture portal, launched on 29 November 2017, to uphold ATO training standards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Learning and Skills))
sentences.text: To ensure and uphold the standards of ATOs' training, SSG recently introduced a community feedback feature in the MySkillsFuture portal which was launched on 29 November 2017.

sections.label: ATO course fee approval
sections.summary: SSG requires ATOs to seek its approval for their course fees.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Learning and Skills))
sentences.text: As for the question of affordability of course fees, SSG requires ATOs to seek its approval for their course fees.

sections.label: Trainer requirements and published information
sections.summary: From October 2014, at least 80% of WSQ trainers need ACTA or equivalent, and SSG will progressively publish course quality and rating information.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For example, you would probably recall that from October 2014, we require the trainers for the WSQ-approved training organisations, at least 80% of their trainers must have Advanced Certificate in Training and Assessment (ACTA) or equivalent.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The question that the Member asked about, whether we can put out more information, she would be glad that this is the intent of SSG and MOE.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I mentioned briefly earlier that the portal called MySkillsFuture portal was launched on 29 November 2017 to help Singaporeans and course applicants to make better, informed decision.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, progressively, starting from this month, SSG will progressively publish information on a few things: the course quality, trainee's rating on course outcome, like what the Member has mentioned.

sections.label: TAE professional competency model
sections.summary: From October 2014, SSG developed the TAE professional competency model, a skills reference framework describing required adult educator competencies and proficiencies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As part of our efforts to enhance the professional standards and also the identity of the adult educators in the Training Adult Education (TAE) industry, SSG has, from October 2014, developed the TAE professional competency model which is a skills reference framework with clear descriptions of the competencies and proficiencies that is required of our adult educators.
